description: Capture desktop, window, or region screenshot. Cross-platform: macOS (screencapture), Linux (maim/scrot/gnome-screenshot/etc.), Windows (PowerShell+.NET). Saves to ~/Documents/screenshots by default (configurable via SCREENSHOT_OUTPUT_DIR env var). For window mode, provide windowName (app name like "Safari") or windowId.

mode.description: fullscreen=entire screen, window=specific app (requires windowName or windowId), region=coordinates

outputPath.description: Absolute path, or relative to home dir

name: take_system_screenshot
